verdict.rationale: Runloop's homepage explicitly claims "10GB image startup time in <2s," which directly matches a few-second cold-start promise. The docs support this with blueprints described as template images for optimized Devbox startup and with snapshots for creating new Devboxes from saved state. The evidence is vendor marketing only. missing for 10: in-depth docs page quantifying cold-start latency (e.g., per blueprint/snapshot/size), independent or hands-on benchmark corroboration.
